title: Targeting MarA N-terminal domain dynamics to prevent DNA binding.
authors: Corbella, Marina; Moreira, Catia; Bello-Madruga, Roberto; Torrent Burgas, Marc; Kamerlin, Shina C L; Blair, Jessica M A; Sancho-Vaello, Enea
journal: Protein science : a publication of the Protein Society
one_liner_zh: 该文结合分子动力学模拟与实验，研究MarA转录因子N端螺旋动态对DNA结合的关键作用，并揭示可迁移至AraC/XylS家族的抑制构象，高度契合TF-DNA互作机制建模课题。
abstract: Efflux is one of the mechanisms employed by Gram-negative bacteria to become resistant to routinely used antibiotics. The inhibition of efflux by targeting their regulators is a promising strategy to re-sensitize bacterial pathogens to antibiotics. AcrAB-TolC is the main resistance-nodulation-division efflux pump in Enterobacteriaceae. MarA is an AraC/XylS family global regulator that regulates more than 40 genes related to the antimicrobial resistance phenotype, including acrAB. The aim of this work was to understand the role of the N-terminal helix of MarA in the mechanism of DNA binding. An N-terminal deletion of MarA showed that the N-terminal helix is critical for recognition of the functional marboxes. By engineering two double cysteine variants of MarA that form a disulfide bond between the N-terminal helix and the hydrophobic core of one of the helices in direct DNA contact, and combining in vitro electrophoretic mobility assays, in vivo measurements of acrAB transcription using a GFP reporter system, and molecular dynamic simulations, it was shown that the immobilization of the N-terminal helix of MarA prevents binding to DNA. This inhibited conformation seems to be universal for the monomeric members of the AraC/XylS family, as suggested by additional molecular dynamics simulations of the two-domain protein Rob. These results point to the N-terminal helix of the AraC/XylS family monomeric regulators as a promising target for the development of inhibitors.
abstract_zh: 外排是革兰氏阴性菌对常规使用抗生素产生耐药性的机制之一。通过靶向其调控因子来抑制外排，是使细菌病原体重新对抗生素敏感的一种有前景的策略。AcrAB-TolC是肠杆菌科中主要的耐药结节化细胞分裂（resistance-nodulation-division）外排泵。MarA是AraC/XylS家族的全局调控因子，调控包括acrAB在内的40多个与抗菌药物耐药表型相关的基因。本研究旨在理解MarA N端螺旋在DNA结合机制中的作用。MarA的N端缺失表明，N端螺旋对于识别功能性marboxes至关重要。通过工程化两个双半胱氨酸变体，在N端螺旋与直接接触DNA的一个螺旋的疏水核心之间形成二硫键，并结合体外电泳迁移率实验、使用GFP报告系统对acrAB转录的体内测量以及分子动力学 (molecular dynamics) 模拟，结果表明MarA N端螺旋的固定化阻止了其与DNA的结合。这种抑制构象似乎对AraC/XylS家族的单体成员具有普遍性，这通过对双结构域蛋白Rob的额外分子动力学模拟得到了提示。这些结果指出，AraC/XylS家族单体调控因子的N端螺旋是开发抑制剂的一个有前景的靶点。
